values.task_boundary: Define exactly one successor closeout plan; perform no closeout or release action.
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: Release plan and checklist name the same complete closeout denominator
AC-2: TAIL-01 through TAIL-10 appear in exact order with explicit dependencies
AC-3: Operator authorization gates release/tag/publication actions
AC-4: Typed finish and cleanup are asynchronous and non-gating
AC-5: The plan distinguishes product completion, reviewed merge, release ceremony, and bookkeeping
AC-6: Focused validators pass and exact-head review has no unresolved actionable findings
